statedReasoning: Government bill (predkladatel: ministr spravedlnosti -- Ministry of Justice) amending zákon č. 256/2004 Sb., o podnikání na kapitálovém trhu, and related laws 'v souvislosti s podporou vyváženého zastoupení žen a mužů ve vedoucích orgánech některých emitentů' (balanced representation of women and men in the leading bodies of certain issuers). Having now read the actual bill text (Čl. I), this directly and precisely transposes EU Directive (EU) 2022/2381 of 23 Nov 2022 on gender balance among directors of listed companies (cited by CELEX 32022L2381 directly in the bill's own footnote amendment). The bill inserts a new Part Thirteen (ČÁST TŘINÁCTÁ, new §§134l-134o+) into 256/2004 Sb.: §134m scopes the obligation to issuers with an average of at least 250 employees in the last completed accounting period AND either annual net turnover exceeding EUR 50,000,000 or total assets exceeding EUR 43,000,000 (matching the directive's own thresholds verbatim); §134n requires each covered issuer to choose either (a) at least 40% of non-executive board seats held by the less-represented sex, or (b) at least 33% of all board seats (executive + non-executive combined) held by the less-represented sex -- also matching the directive verbatim; the ČNB is tasked with monitoring/enforcement. This is a precise, faithful, non-gold-plated transposition, not an invention -- confirmed by direct primary-text reading, not just secondary description. The EU transposition deadline was 28 December 2024 and the substantive compliance-target application deadline is 30 June 2026 -- meaning this Czech implementing bill, still in committee as of 24 Jul 2026, is running behind both dates. Czech-language news coverage (Echo24, e15.cz) independently corroborates the same 40%/33% figures and describes it as a 'minimalist' implementation of the EU requirement.
researchedContext: The census shows undercount=2: the graph only recorded 256/2004 Sb. as amended, but the real amended-laws list is [198/2009, 256/2004, 99/1963]. This is a coherent, plausible set for this bill's actual subject: 198/2009 Sb. is the antidiskriminační zákon (Anti-Discrimination Act), a natural companion amendment for a gender-balance-on-boards law since it likely aligns enforcement/definitions with existing discrimination-law mechanisms; 99/1963 Sb. is the občanský soudní řád (Code of Civil Procedure), plausibly amended to add or adapt a judicial/injunctive enforcement route for non-compliant boards. Both are real, well-known Czech statutes and the combination is substantively consistent with implementing an EU board-diversity directive that requires member states to provide effective enforcement mechanisms -- this reads as a genuine title-regex undercount, not noise, and is worth flagging as a data-quality finding. Legislative history independently confirms: submission by the Justice Ministry 1 Jun 2026, Organizational Committee proceeding recommendation 3 Jun 2026 (rapporteur Bc. Hana Anžincová), first-reading general debate 2 Jul 2026 (24th session) where the Chamber voted AGAINST approving it in first reading alone and instead sent it to committees, with the Constitutional-Legal Committee review still pending as of 24 Jul 2026.
